title: Energy Conservation Ledger

implementation_qualification.failed_predecessor_reason: The first gate applied -Werror to unchanged canonical dependencies and exposed pre-existing REAL equality warnings. The gate was corrected so all new EB-I01 production code and tests remain under -Werror while only unchanged canonical dependencies permit compare-reals warnings.
gate_assertions: Whole-system internal transfers cancel from the conservation residual.
Nested soil and canopy control volumes close independently.
The generic projector rejects undeclared positive transfer endpoints.
The runtime ledger rejects unregistered positive transfer endpoints without corrupting the active trial.
A real accepted F-KT receipt publishes the prepared energy balance exactly once.
Rollback publishes no energy record and replay from the same committed origin remains valid.
The unchanged FMR18 receipt and mass-transaction path is replayed without linking EB-I01.

contract.reference_area: owning logical SWAP column or tile area
contract.direction_convention: non-negative magnitude with explicit source_component -> target_component direction
contract.component_registration: component id 0 is the sole exterior marker; every positive transfer endpoint must be registered in the trial storage snapshot and present in both initial and final storage snapshots used for projection
contract.unknown_positive_endpoint_policy: fail closed before projection/publication; never reinterpret an undeclared internal store as an external boundary flux
contract.nested_control_volume_rule: a registered positive component omitted from a selected nested control volume is outside that nested volume but remains inside the registered logical system
contract.transaction_authority: existing fmr_accepted_commit_receipt_t after successful physical kernel commit
contract.committed_energy_record: compact provenance plus aggregate whole-system balance; no persistent transfer graph

invariant_assessment.evidence: Generic kernel energy-accounting types are not use-case-specific and add no alternate SWAP kernel.
Production energy modules contain no file, path, parser or I/O primitive dependency; the qualification gate checks this explicitly.

Energy storage snapshots, registered component identity, directed transfers, transaction provenance and committed diagnostics are explicit separate types and do not modify forcing or physical state types.
No persistent per-column physical state is added. The committed record is compact and the trial transfer graph is discarded before publication.
energy_trial_ledger_t is worker/job trial scratch; transfer storage exists only for an active trial.
The API does not require object-per-column persistent storage and permits worker reuse, but large-batch memory/cache/vectorization performance is not qualified by EB-I01.
prepare -> accepted physical commit receipt -> publish is explicit. Rollback/abort publishes no energy record and replay from the same committed origin is tested.
Remote integration testing proves rollback followed by replay from the same committed physical revision and interval.
Ledger provenance uses generic real-valued [t0,t1] intervals and contains no day, month, year or midnight assumption.
No fixed coupling-window duration or calendar boundary is encoded.
Energy publication is aligned with the existing transactional runtime receipt and is usable in coupled execution without depending on a groundwater-specific ledger.
EB-I01 does not alter the SWAP-MODFLOW head/flux interface contract.
No existing mass source is changed. The unchanged FMR18 receipt/mass transaction test is recompiled and executed without linking EB-I01, O0/O2-identically.
EB-I01 adds conservation accounting only and does not alter groundwater interface sensitivities.
The ledger adds bookkeeping to an existing trial and accepted commit; it does not require extra full SWAP predictor/corrector runs.
Worker-local lifetime and optional allocation are compatible with MultiSWAP, but no hundred-thousand-column throughput or concurrency qualification is claimed.
The ledger knows only the logical column/tile reference area. Tile fractions and MODFLOW-cell aggregation are explicitly excluded from the kernel contract.
No deep-vadose transfer-zone behavior is changed.
No component transition between deep-vadose and direct groundwater coupling is changed.
Accounting components and transfers are generic and have no dependency on one Richards implementation.
The accounting API is available to shared physics, but existing heat/canopy/surface process wiring into it is intentionally deferred to later energy workunits.
No HeadCalc internals or legacy hydraulic arrays are referenced.
The accounting contract introduces no solver policy and changes no physical option.

No bounded-cost large-transfer-graph or pathological-column performance qualification is part of EB-I01. Projection and duplicate validation costs are therefore not claimed as production-scale bounded.
Existing reference transaction behavior is preserved and replayed unchanged; EB-I01 does not remove or weaken reference-mode capability.
A compact committed energy balance with transaction provenance is available, but runtime-wide diagnostics aggregation/reporting is not yet wired.
Transfer arrays are allocated only for an active energy trial; EB-I01 adds no mandatory energy allocation to every canonical column state.
Tile-area composition and MODFLOW aggregation remain outside the kernel; runtime receipt authority controls publication.
Production code contains no .swp, MODFLOW, calendar-start, midnight or fixed-duration assumption.
This audit explicitly records the EB-I01 change against all SWAP core architecture invariants.

explicit_non_claims: Existing SWAP physical heat/energy processes are not yet wired into the ledger.
No scientific qualification of a heat solver is provided by EB-I01.
No large-batch MultiSWAP throughput or memory benchmark is provided by EB-I01.
No concurrent-worker race/stress test is provided by EB-I01.
No bounded-cost production qualification for large or pathological transfer graphs is provided by EB-I01.
No MODFLOW-cell or tile-fraction energy aggregation is performed by EB-I01.
No runtime-wide serialization/reporting contract is admitted by EB-I01.
No independent verifier qualification is claimed by this owner workunit.
Current-canonical admission is not claimed by this workbranch audit.
